Construct a reference for population diet scoring

Source: R/diet-reference.R
diet_reference.Rd

Creates a small, method-specific reference for DASH or HEI-2015 indices, including HEI-2015 totals calculated from raw inputs. Raw DASH with custom definitions requires explicit dash_cutpoints in score_le8() to specify intake quintiles as well. The four values are index-score cutpoints at the indicated percentiles, not percentiles themselves. No observations are stored or ranked.

Usage

diet_reference(
  p25,
  p50,
  p75,
  p95,
  method = "dash",
  label = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  score_range = NULL
)

Arguments

p25, p50, p75, p95

Single finite numeric cutpoints, in nondecreasing order.

method

Either "dash" or "hei2015", matched case-insensitively.

label, source

Optional single nonempty strings describing the reference population and its source. These do not change scoring.

score_range

Optional numeric vector of two finite bounds identifying the index's theoretical range. HEI-2015 always uses 0 to 100. DASH has multiple definitions, so a custom DASH reference has no implicit range.

Value

An essential8_diet_reference object containing the method, cutpoints, optional metadata, and index range. It identifies percentile bands, not an exact continuous percentile distribution.

Examples

ref <- diet_reference(40, 55, 65, 80, method = "hei2015",
                      label = "Synthetic example")
ref
#> Diet reference: hei2015 
#> Population: Synthetic example 
#> p25 p50 p75 p95 
#>  40  55  65  80
